CCM branding visible on the frame and saddle.
Shockwave model name on the top tube.
Front suspension fork and rear coil spring suspension.
Significant rust visible on the front fork stanchions in photo 2.
Equipped with a kickstand, bell, and a left-side mirror.
V-brakes visible on the front wheel.

claims.evidence: photo 2 shows heavy rust on the front fork stanchions.
photo 0 and 1 show CCM decals on the frame and saddle.
photo 0 shows both front fork and rear shock absorbers.

claims.claim: Perfect for teenagers or kids between 8...

risks.risk: Front suspension may be seized or non-functional due to rust.
risks.proof: A video showing the front fork compressing and rebounding smoothly.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly due to cable stretch or derailleur damage.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled while shifting through all gears.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full drivetrain service and new cables.

risks.risk: Tires may have dry rot or hidden punctures.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls and tread.

proof_requests: Video of the front suspension compressing and rebounding.
Video of the gears shifting through the full range while the rear wheel is off the ground.
Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls to check for cracking.
Photo of the underside of the frame to check for cracks or heavy impacts.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a CCM Shockwave. However, visible rust on the suspension components contradicts the 'clean' description, so it must be priced as a project bike requiring maintenance.
